answer: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is open Mondays to Wednesdays and Fridays 10:00am–6:00pm, and Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays 10:00am–9:00pm. On Christmas Eve and Lunar New Year's Eve it is open 10:00am–5:00pm. It is closed on Thursdays (except public holidays) and the first two days of the Lunar New Year. The Box Office closes 30 minutes before the Museum closes.
